churn_caveat_r5: CRITICAL CAVEAT: Neither bracketed nor segment churn model validates satisfaction→churn causation in this dataset. At segment-based lower bound (0.15pp churn improvement), LTV/CAC remains ~1.49x (essentially unchanged from current 1.47x). At bracketed upper bound (0.64pp, relying on industry benchmarks), LTV/CAC reaches ~1.84x. The recommendation (Zone Governance) is justified primarily by: (1) structural CM diversification (less surge-dependent), (2) competitive defensibility (zone caps invisible until request), (3) regulatory positioning (self-regulation narrative). Churn/retention improvement is a potential upside, not the primary thesis.
recommendation_primary_thesis: Structural (CM diversification + competitive defensibility + regulatory positioning), NOT churn improvement
nrr_note: NRR is revenue-weighted (94.2%), not customer-weighted (85.4%). Churned customers are low-value (mostly rare riders). Previous 85.4% figure was customer retention rate mislabeled as NRR.
weather_confounding_verdict: NEGLIGIBLE confounding: precip-surge corr=-0.004, precip-completion corr=0.002. No causal confound pathway. Stratified elasticities differ by 10.6% (likely sampling). Conservative estimate: 0.212 (high-precip) vs 0.22 (all). Use 0.22 as primary; 0.212 as conservative lower bound.
